topic: K-Stick and the Tiny Umbrella That Only Covers His Cap
background: Simple sidewalk with a small cloud and light cartoon raindrops
main_expression: Confident grin that quickly becomes puzzled
main_pose: Standing proudly while holding a tiny umbrella above his head
scene_1: K-Stick sees raindrops and proudly opens a tiny umbrella, standing underneath it.
scene_2: The umbrella covers only his red cap while the rest of his body gets lightly sprinkled. K-Stick keeps smiling and gives a confident thumbs-up.
scene_3: He notices his cap is completely dry and proudly points at it like a weather expert.
twist_ending: A single raindrop lands on his nose, and the tiny umbrella instantly flips inside out. K-Stick calmly puts the umbrella on his cap like a hat and says, "Still protected!"
facebook_caption: When your umbrella protects the most important part... your hat! ☔😂
youtube_description: K-Stick faces a little rain with a very little umbrella. It may not protect him, but his signature red cap stays perfectly dry!
